src.label: USDA APHIS — pet travel from the United States to Colombia (relaying Colombian rules)

head: No import permit for personal pets, but a health certificate endorsed within 10 days of travel.
lines: The US agriculture department page on Colombian entry says personal pet dogs and cats do not need an import permit.

They must carry a health certificate from an accredited vet endorsed within 10 days of travel, the rabies vaccination certificate, and at least one photocopy of the original certificate. Notarisation and a Colombian consular stamp are not needed.
The page says Colombia will reject pets that do not meet the certificate requirements. This is a US-side relay, so confirm with the Colombian agriculture institute.
